method: Normal production build, fresh save fixture imported through Settings. Browser operator clicked the Merchant label, captured read-only status samples and a 30-second canvas video. Independent CLI analysis checks every sampled position and consecutive segment with the unchanged production navigation; independent image inspection verifies complete-house fade and restoration.

occlusion.independentImageReview: Whole house including roof, walls, ladder, courtyard wall and awning is translucent at the imported close start; Adventurer remains visible. After routing around the house and closing trade, the same building is opaque again.

limitations: Sampled geometry checks supplement browser movement; the short video is canvas-only and does not include DOM labels/panels. Separate PNG records retain those UI states. The distant initial fixture was not occluded and its image is named route-start-distant.png; it is not fade evidence.
